<translate>
<!--T:1-->
'''Gravity''' weighs on every fighter in DragonMineZ. Each dimension has its own gravity, and a [[Special:MyLanguage/Gravity Device|Gravity Device]] can raise it further inside a sealed room. Higher gravity makes you train faster, but it also weakens and slows you. Combined with [[Special:MyLanguage/Weights|Weights]], it is the core of the fastest training setups.

<!--T:2-->
All numbers on this page are server defaults.
</translate>
{{Config|Gravity Config}}

<translate>
== Where gravity comes from == <!--T:3-->

<!--T:4-->
Your '''raw gravity''' is built like this:

<!--T:5-->
# The '''base''' is the highest of: the gravity of your dimension, the gravity of a protected region (with WorldGuard, the <code>dmz-gravity</code> region flag) and the gravity near [[Special:MyLanguage/King Kai|King Kai]] (10× within 100 blocks of a King Kai NPC).
# While you stand inside the room of an active [[Special:MyLanguage/Gravity Device|Gravity Device]], the device's gravity is added on top (a device set to 50× adds 49).
</translate>
{| class="wikitable"
! <translate><!--T:6--> Dimension</translate> !! <translate><!--T:7--> Gravity</translate>
|-
| {{L|Earth}} || ×1
|-
| <translate><!--T:8--> The Nether</translate> || ×8
|-
| <translate><!--T:9--> The End</translate> || ×20
|-
| {{L|Hyperbolic Time Chamber}} || ×10
|-
| {{L|Otherworld}} || ×1
|-
| {{L|Namek}} || ×1
|-
| <translate><!--T:10--> Any other dimension</translate> || ×1
|}

<translate>
== Net gravity == <!--T:11-->

<!--T:12-->
Your raw gravity is then reduced by your stats to get your '''net gravity'''. If raw gravity is 1 or less, net gravity is 0. Your stats only cancel a noticeable amount of gravity at very high levels.

<!--T:13-->
Net gravity is what drives everything below.
</translate>

<translate>
== What gravity does == <!--T:14-->

=== Training bonuses === <!--T:15-->

<!--T:16-->
* '''+2.5% TP''' per point of net gravity.
* '''+0.25% form mastery''' per point of net gravity.
* Gravity also '''amplifies the weight''' you wear, pushing you into higher training zones (see [[Special:MyLanguage/Weights|Weights]]).

<!--T:17-->
In the [[Special:MyLanguage/Hyperbolic Time Chamber|Hyperbolic Time Chamber]], the chamber's own gravity doesn't count for the TP bonus, because the chamber has its own TP multiplier. A Gravity Device placed inside still counts.
</translate>

<translate>

</translate>

<translate>
=== The hard stop === <!--T:38-->

<!--T:39-->
At '''75 net gravity''' or more, flight is fully disabled, jumping takes the maximum penalty, and the gravity TP and mastery bonuses drop to nothing.
</translate>

<translate>
== Weight training zones == <!--T:40-->

<!--T:41-->
On top of gravity, the weights you wear put you in a '''training zone''' based on how much weight you carry compared with an ideal for your level: '''None''', '''Comfortable''', '''Ideal''', '''Pushing Hard''' or '''Overloaded'''. The zone sets a separate TP multiplier (up to ×2.5) and, past the Ideal zone, a stat penalty of up to 60% that also slows your movement and attacks. The weight penalty is added to the gravity stat reduction, and the total is still capped at 90%. See [[Special:MyLanguage/Weights|Weights]] for the full table.

<!--T:42-->
The zone also multiplies the stamina cost of your attacks and the ki, health and stamina drain of your active forms: ×1.15 Comfortable, ×1.3 Ideal, ×1.5 Pushing Hard, ×2.0 Overloaded.
</translate>

<translate>
== Gravity Room upgrades == <!--T:43-->

<!--T:44-->
Bulma's sidequests '''Gravity Room Mk.II''' and '''Gravity Room Mk.III''' unlock dampeners that reduce the '''weight stat penalty''' while you stand inside an '''active Gravity Device's''' room:

<!--T:45-->
* '''Mk.II''' removes up to 50% of the weight penalty.
* '''Mk.III''' replaces Mk.II and removes up to 80%.

<!--T:46-->
The relief fades as you get stronger, and Mk.III fades more slowly than Mk.II.
</translate>

<translate>
== Checking your gravity == <!--T:47-->

<!--T:48-->
The '''Gravity''' row of the Stats menu ({{Key|V}}) shows everything live: environmental and net gravity, stat penalty, TP bonus, your weight (raw and effective), your ideal weight, your training zone and the weight-training multiplier. Inside an active Gravity Device's room, a visual effect also covers the screen. It grows with the device's gravity and reaches full intensity at 60×.
</translate>
